blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU City, Philippines — A video posted online of students crossing a swelling river to go to school and back to their homes in a mountain barangay in Balamban town in western Cebu has prompted an appeal for help from Cebu Gov. Pamela Baricuatro. The video taken on the afternoon of Oct. 15, 2026, showed students and residents braving to cross the swollen river just to get to school and back home in Sitio Bonbon, Brgy. Luca of this town. Some of the residents were also seen wading through the muddy waters to get to the other side to get to […]...
